title: 查询员工及所在部门
objective: 用员工外键连接部门表并按月薪筛选。
statement: 列出 salary 不低于 9000 元的员工，输出 employee_id（employees.id）、employee_name、department_name、salary；9000 元也保留，同部门员工各占一行，不要求行顺序。
knowledge: employees.department_id 指向 departments.id；部门 id 唯一，因此每名员工最多配到一个部门。内连接只保留 ON 条件配对成功的员工。
employees 和 departments 都有 name，输出时用 e.name 表示员工姓名、d.name 表示部门名称；e、d 是表别名。
salary >= 9000 包含刘敏和孙鹏的 9000 元边界。内连接中把这个筛选写入 WHERE 或同时作为 ON 条件都可筛掉不符合的配对；此处 WHERE 更直接表达员工月薪条件。
starterSql: -- 关联员工与部门，只保留月薪不低于 9000 元的员工。

hints.text: 沿 department_id 与部门 id 配对，再筛选月薪；结果仍然一行一名员工。
给 employees、departments 分别取别名，JOIN 后用 ON e.department_id = d.id 配对，WHERE e.salary >= 9000 筛行。
SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name, ____ AS department_name, e.salary FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON ____ WHERE ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, e.salary FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.department_id WHERE e.salary >= 9000;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 内连接通过外键与部门主键配对，再筛出月薪不低于 9000 元的员工。部门编号唯一，故每名匹配员工一行；输出时用别名区分两张表的 name。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, e.salary FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.department_id;
SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, e.salary FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.department_id WHERE e.salary > 9000;
SELECT e.id AS employee_id, e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS department_name, e.salary FROM employees AS e JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.id WHERE e.salary >= 9000;
